name: medical-collapse
description: An attendee collapses at the entrance; bystanders start CPR and nobody knows where the AED is.

ticks.narrative: 10:52 Reception: an attendee in his fifties collapsed by the registration desk at the entrance, unresponsive and not breathing normally. A bystander has started CPR. 911 has been called from a mobile phone. Nobody at the desk knows where the AED is. A crowd of about 15 is gathering and blocking the corridor to the main_stage.
